reviews_5s: Esta muy buen articulo funciona perfectamente la aconsejo 100%GoodMuy buen producto para uso diario 🗣🗣🗣Spectacular, very good quality, lightweight, includes accessories to insert and remove the discs. Discs are not included with the product.Works greatI have a smaller 4in Makita angle grinder that I've used for years. And while it's mostly gotten the job done, it's become increasingly more difficult to find all of the 4in wheels and brushes that are available for the slightly larger 4-1/2 in grinders. Finally I decided to buy the Dewalt Angle Grinder Tool, 4-1/2-Inch, 11-Amp (DWE402K). This thing is a beast! Because this thing is such a powerful little machine (11 amps at 11,000 rpm), I strongly urge anyone buying this angle grinder to read all of the instructions, including ALL of the stuff about safety. Seriously - this is not a toy. This is a high-powered machine designed to do some really tough work. When turned on, it will almost jump out of your hands if you're not expecting the torque this thing has. I've come to buy numerous different wheels and brushes and this has been a pure joy to use. It is such a well-designed machine. The DWE402K comes with the basic DWE402 grinder, but includes a hard plastic case which I really like. While my new Dewalt grinder hasn't been in its case since I bought it, I like having cases for all my shop tools. When finished with a project and I'm cleaning up my shop, I like to clean up all of my tools and put them away in their respective cases together with any special tools or attachments. The dewalt comes with an allen wrench which I've never needed (stays in the case). And (sadly) there's not much spare room in the case for extra wheels or brushes. As for the grinder itself - I really like it for its design and ability to do real work. On some grinders, the guard is more of a pain because it's always in the way and can't be easily adjusted. So it's taken off and never put back on. That's shameful. Always use your guard, it's there to protect you. The guard on the Dewalt is genius. This guard is designed the way all guards should be. It can be easily rotated 360 degrees to any direction (read the instructions so you understand exactly how this works - and never try to adjust the guard without unplugging the grinder first) and the guard can be completely removed if ever needed. The 5/8in spindle is perfectly designed for quick changing wheels and brushes. The spin-on and off feature makes this a truly tool-less grinder. No special tools are needed to remove and replace wheels and brushes. Just twist them off an on with your hand. Again - unplug the grinder first - right?! The grinder also comes with a pair of 5/8in-to-7/8in "arbor" or a flat-washer-looking-thing for compressing wheels that don't spin-on to the spindle using threads, but rather have a larger clearance-hole, non-threaded diameter hole for mounting. It's a great system that requires no tools. The on-off control for the grinder is a simple paddle wheel with a built-in safety switch ... it's a breeze to use. Very comfortable. There's also an over-ride lock so you don't have to continuously hold down the paddle switch when working on large areas at a time. The power cord is tough but it's only 6ft long which in my mind seems a little short. My personal preference would be an 8ft or 10ft power cord. The only other improvement would be some sort of easy sky-hook to hang the grinder on the side of a bench or table. Bottom line, this Dewalt DWE402K Angle Grinder is the bomb! If you have serious work that needs to be done - this is the defacto standard in angle grinders. Seriously, this is one powerful and potentially dangerous beast of a tool in the wrong hands. For me - this is exactly what I was looking for! Be careful out there!Great toolPowerful grinder that gets the job done.Me encantó era lo que necesitaba para limpiar los hierro de L acasaComo lo esperaban lo mejor
reviews_1s:
The box arrived very beat up, with no outer packing. I needed it as a Christmas gift, so I just wrapped it up and hoped it would be ok. When it was opened on Christmas, it was missing any internal packaging. It had no bag, and the side was all scratched up. It made a very loud chattering sound when it was turned on (we tried it without a grinding disc, just to see if it worked). There was also a burning scent when it was run for a few seconds. Angle grinders are loud, but something was obviously wrong with the machine. We also discovered that it was missing the wrench that was supposed to come with it. We returned it.I’ve used many angle grinders over the years, but this DEWALT DWE402 left me seriously disappointed. I accidentally dropped it from just three feet, and it immediately broke—damaging both the field coil and the armature. Now, when turned on, it runs in reverse!

I’ve dropped other grinders from much greater heights without any issues, so this was unexpected. Unfortunately, it seems like the durability just isn’t what it used to be. If you need a tough, long-lasting grinder, I’d recommend looking elsewhere.Grinder is great but it does not come with a tool to tighten the grinding disc.They will not warranty this product. After 5 weeks of waiting they always just blame the customer. Absurd. Never been more disappointed with a US tool manufacturer.

Did some grinding and cutting on a vehicle restoration with it, so light work for an 11 amp grinder and it is now glowing when I turn it on (see video). Obviously the motor is burnt up. I’m a big Dewalt fan, have several corded tools, have used their cordless tools for more years than I care to mention, heck I was even overpaying for their cutting and grinding wheels on this project.

Now their customer service. I reached out to Dewalt about this issue and am being told I need to return it so they can look at it and decide if they’ll repair it or not. It’ll take 5-6 weeks.If you buy this grinder you'll need to be prepared get an array of tools to detach whatever blades you will use on it. After just one use, the blade gets welded to the grinder and it is humanly impossible to remove it. This tool is not for the ordinary DYI user.Unfortunately, there is no seller review, although the product may be good, I gave one star because the seller took 3 weeks to ship the product. Very disappointed.The tool looks fine, but did not include a pin wrench for loosening or tightening the arbor. Instead, it included an Allen wrench (!), which is of no use whatever with this tool. Also, it did not come with a handle, despite the product picture showing it having a handle. I talked to an Amazon rep, who was of no help, saying send it back or find what you need locally. I lack spare time to go shopping locally and I need the tool NOW, so I ordered the pin wrench from Amazon, and fashioned a handle from a 3/8" bolt.
Disappointing overall.Attached picture shows the item description, which states it includes a 4.5 inch wheel. Our package did not include an actual wheel. In addition, the product says made in USA, and when trying to repair the equipment time later, I find that there are pieces made in CHINA!
